[RoutineDef,RC_CBF_Publish,
    [RoutineCall,RC_CBF_Invalidate]
    [MVarDef,FBFCache,16+([SubToolGetCount]*5),0]
    [MVarSet,FBFCache,1,[SubToolGetCount]]

    [MVarSet,FBFCache,3,[MVarGet,FB25Data,8]]
    [MVarSet,FBFCache,4,[MVarGet,FB25Data,9]]
    [MVarSet,FBFCache,5,[MVarGet,FB25Data,25745]]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CBF_UsedCameras]
    [Loop,2048,[VarSet,cbFastHead(cbFastI),-1],cbFastI]
    [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
        [VarSet,cbFastID,[SubToolGetID,cbFastI]]
        [VarSet,cbFastHigh(cbFastI),INT(cbFastID/65536)]
        [VarSet,cbFastLow(cbFastI),cbFastID-(cbFastHigh(cbFastI)*65536)]
        [VarSet,cbFastB,16+(cbFastI*5)]
        [MVarSet,FBFCache,cbFastB,cbFastLow(cbFastI)]
        [MVarSet,FBFCache,cbFastB+1,cbFastHigh(cbFastI)]
        [MVarSet,FBFCache,cbFastB+2,cbTrackGroups(cbFastI)]
        [VarSet,cbFastBucket,(cbFastLow(cbFastI)+(cbFastHigh(cbFastI)*17))&2047]
        [VarSet,cbFastPeer,cbFastHead(cbFastBucket)]
        [Loop,cbFastI,
            [If,cbFastPeer<0,[LoopExit]]
            [If,(cbFastLow(cbFastPeer)==cbFastLow(cbFastI))&&(cbFastHigh(cbFastPeer)==cbFastHigh(cbFastI)),
                [VarSet,cbFastG,cbTrackGroups(cbFastI)-1]
                [VarSet,cbFastP,cbTrackGroups(cbFastPeer)-1]
                [If,cbFastG!=cbFastP,
                    [MVarSet,FBFCache,cbFastB+4,1][MVarSet,FBFCache,16+(cbFastPeer*5)+4,1]
                    [If,(([MVarGet,FB25Data,25746+(cbFastG*2)]&cbFastUsedLow)!=([MVarGet,FB25Data,25746+(cbFastP*2)]&cbFastUsedLow))||(([MVarGet,FB25Data,25747+(cbFastG*2)]&cbFastUsedHigh)!=([MVarGet,FB25Data,25747+(cbFastP*2)]&cbFastUsedHigh)),
                        [MVarSet,FBFCache,cbFastB+3,1][MVarSet,FBFCache,16+(cbFastPeer*5)+3,1]
                    ]
                ]
            ]
            [VarSet,cbFastPeer,cbFastNext(cbFastPeer)]
        ]

    ,cbFastI]
    // Publish only after every cache entry and ambiguity flag is complete.
    [MVarSet,FBFCache,0,1]

[RoutineDef,RC_CBF_TryCache,
    [VarSet,cbFastCacheHit,0]
    [If,[MemGetSize,FBFCache]>0,
        [If,[MVarGet,FBFCache,0]==1,
            [If,([MVarGet,FBFCache,1]==[SubToolGetCount])&&([MVarGet,FBFCache,2]==[ToolGetActiveIndex]),
                [If,([MVarGet,FBFCache,3]==[MVarGet,FB25Data,8])&&([MVarGet,FBFCache,4]==[MVarGet,FB25Data,9]),
                    [If,[MVarGet,FBFCache,5]==[MVarGet,FB25Data,25745],[VarSet,cbFastCacheHit,1]]
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
    [If,cbFastCacheHit==1,
        [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
            [VarSet,cbFastB,16+(cbFastI*5)]
            [VarSet,cbFastID,[SubToolGetID,cbFastI]][VarSet,cbFastHi,INT(cbFastID/65536)]
            [VarSet,cbFastLo,cbFastID-(cbFastHi*65536)]
            [If,(cbFastLo!=[MVarGet,FBFCache,cbFastB])||(cbFastHi!=[MVarGet,FBFCache,cbFastB+1]),[VarSet,cbFastCacheHit,0][LoopExit]]
            [VarSet,cbTrackGroups(cbFastI),[MVarGet,FBFCache,cbFastB+2]]
        ,cbFastI]
    ]
    [If,cbFastCacheHit==1,
        [VarSet,cbFastSelected,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]]
        [VarSet,cbTrackPrefix,[StrMerge,"CB",[MVarGet,FB25Data,8],[MVarGet,FB25Data,9],"G"]]
        [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ReadName][RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ParseTag,cbTrackName]
        [If,cbParsedGroup!=cbTrackGroups(cbFastSelected),
            [VarSet,cbFastCacheHit,0]
            // Preserve the reviewed first-SubTool filename alias exception.
            [If,(cbFastSelected==0)&&(cbTagCount==0),
                [VarSet,cbFastTool,[ToolGetActiveIndex]][VarSet,cbFastPath,[ToolGetPath,cbFastTool]]
                [VarSet,cbFastAlias,[FileNameExtract,cbFastPath,6]]
                [If,([StrLength,cbFastAlias]>0)&&([StrLength,cbFastAlias]==[StrLength,cbTrackName]),
                    [If,[StrFind,cbFastAlias,cbTrackName]==0,
                        [RoutineCall,RC_CB321_ResolveFirstID]
                        [If,cbFirstIdGroup==cbTrackGroups(0),[VarSet,cbFastCacheHit,1]]
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ]
    [If,cbFastCacheHit==1,
        [VarSet,cbFastNeedsSelection,0]
        [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
            [If,[MVarGet,FBFCache,16+(cbFastI*5)+3+cbFastStoreCheck]==1,[VarSet,cbFastNeedsSelection,1][LoopExit]]
        ,cbFastI]
        [If,cbFastNeedsSelection==1,
            [If,[MemGetSize,RCFBFReadView]>0,[MemDelete,RCFBFReadView]]
            [MVarDef,RCFBFReadView,12,0][MTransformGet,RCFBFReadView,0]
            [MVarSet,RCFBFReadView,9,[CanvasZoomGet]]
            [MVarSet,RCFBFReadView,10,[CanvasPanGetH]][MVarSet,RCFBFReadView,11,[CanvasPanGetV]]
            [IFreeze,[Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
                [If,[MVarGet,FBFCache,16+(cbFastI*5)+3+cbFastStoreCheck]==1,
                    [SubToolSelect,cbFastI][RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ReadName][RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ParseTag,cbTrackName]
                    [If,cbParsedGroup!=cbTrackGroups(cbFastI),[VarSet,cbFastCacheHit,0][LoopExit]]
                ]
            ,cbFastI]]
            [SubToolSelect,cbFastSelected][MTransformSet,RCFBFReadView,0]
            [CanvasZoomSet,[MVarGet,RCFBFReadView,9]][CanvasPanSet,[MVarGet,RCFBFReadView,10],[MVarGet,RCFBFReadView,11]]
            [MemDelete,RCFBFReadView]
        ]
    ]
]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_CheckTracked,
    [RoutineCall,RC_CBF_TryCache]
    [If,cbFastCacheHit==1,[VarSet,cbTrackValid,1][VarSet,cbTrackError,""],
        [RoutineCall,RC_CBF_Invalidate]
        [IFreeze,[RoutineCall,RC_CBF_FullCheck]]

    ]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB321_ResolveFirstID,
    [VarSet,cbFirstIdGroup,0]
    [If,[MemGetSize,FB25Data]>=123088,
        [VarSet,cbIdRecords,[MVarGet,FB25Data,27771]]
        [VarSet,cbTargetId,[SubToolGetID,0]]
        [VarSet,cbTargetHi,INT(cbTargetId/65536)]
        [VarSet,cbTargetLo,cbTargetId-(cbTargetHi*65536)]
        [VarSet,cbIdOK,1]
        [Loop,1000,[VarSet,cbIdRemaining(cbIdI),0],cbIdI]
        [Loop,cbIdRecords,
            [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,27772+(cbIdI*3)]==cbTargetLo)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,27773+(cbIdI*3)]==cbTargetHi),
                [VarSet,cbIdGroup,[MVarGet,FB25Data,27774+(cbIdI*3)]-1]
                [VarInc,cbIdRemaining(cbIdGroup)]
            ]
        ,cbIdI]
        [Loop,[SubToolGetCount]-1,
            [VarSet,cbIdPeer,cbIdI+1]
            [If,[SubToolGetID,cbIdPeer]==cbTargetId,
                [VarSet,cbIdGroup,cbTrackGroups(cbIdPeer)-1]
                [VarSet,cbIdRemaining(cbIdGroup),cbIdRemaining(cbIdGroup)-1]
                [If,cbIdRemaining(cbIdGroup)<0,[VarSet,cbIdOK,0]]
            ]
        ,cbIdI]
        [Loop,[MVarGet,FB25Data,25745],
            [If,cbIdRemaining(cbIdI)>0,
                [If,cbFirstIdGroup>0,[VarSet,cbIdOK,0]]
                [VarSet,cbFirstIdGroup,cbIdI+1]
            ]
        ,cbIdI]
        [If,cbIdOK==0,[VarSet,cbFirstIdGroup,0]]
    ]
]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_Bit,
    [VarSet,cbTrackHalf,0][VarSet,cbBitSlot,cbSlot]

    [VarSet,cbTrackBit,1]
    [Loop,cbBitSlot,[VarSet,cbTrackBit,cbTrackBit*2]]
,cbSlot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_ReadName,
    [VarSet,cbTrackName,[IGetTitle,"Tool:ItemInfo"]]
    [VarSet,cbNameLength,[StrLength,cbTrackName]]
    [If,cbNameLength>0,
        [VarSet,cbNameLastAsc,[StrToAsc,cbTrackName,cbNameLength-1]]
        [If,cbNameLastAsc==46,
            [VarSet,cbTrackName,[StrExtract,cbTrackName,0,cbNameLength-2]]
        ]
    ]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_ParseTag,
    [VarSet,cbParsedGroup,0][VarSet,cbTagStart,-1][VarSet,cbTagCount,0]
    [Loop,[StrLength,cbTagName],
        [If,[StrLength,cbTagName]>=(cbPos+15),
            [VarSet,cbNativeA,[StrToAsc,cbTagName,cbPos]]
            [VarSet,cbNativeB,[StrToAsc,cbTagName,cbPos+1]]
            [VarSet,cbNativeC,[StrToAsc,cbTagName,cbPos+14]]
            [If,(cbNativeA==67)&&(cbNativeB==66)&&(cbNativeC==71),
                [VarSet,cbDigitsOK,1]
                [Loop,12,
                    [VarSet,cbDigit,[StrToAsc,cbTagName,cbPos+2+cbDigitIndex]]
                    [If,(cbDigit<48)||(cbDigit>57),[VarSet,cbDigitsOK,0]]
                ,cbDigitIndex]
                [If,cbDigitsOK==1,
                    [VarInc,cbTagCount][VarSet,cbTagStart,cbPos]
                    [If,[StrLength,cbTagName]>=(cbPos+20),
                        [VarSet,cbGroupDigits,0]
                        [Loop,4,
                            [VarSet,cbDigit,[StrToAsc,cbTagName,cbPos+15+cbDigitIndex]-48]
                            [If,(cbDigit<0)||(cbDigit>9),[VarSet,cbDigitsOK,0]]
                            [VarSet,cbGroupDigits,(cbGroupDigits*10)+cbDigit]
                        ,cbDigitIndex]
                        [VarSet,cbNativeEnd,[StrToAsc,cbTagName,cbPos+19]]
                        [If,(cbNativeEnd==95)&&(cbDigitsOK==1),
                            [If,[StrLength,cbTrackPrefix]==15,
                                [If,[StrFind,cbTrackPrefix,[StrExtract,cbTagName,cbPos,cbPos+14]]==0,[VarSet,cbParsedGroup,cbGroupDigits]]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ]
    ,cbPos]
    [If,cbTagCount!=1,[VarSet,cbParsedGroup,0]]
,cbTagName]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_CheckLegacyOrder,
    [VarSet,cbTrackValid,1]
    [If,[MemGetSize,FB32LegacyState]>0,
        [If,([SubToolGetCount]!=[MVarGet,FB32LegacyState,0])||([ToolGetActiveIndex]!=[MVarGet,FB32LegacyState,1]),
            [VarSet,cbTrackValid,0]
        ,
            [VarSet,cbLegacySelected,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]]
            [If,[MemGetSize,RCFB32ReadView]>0,[MemDelete,RCFB32ReadView]]
            [MVarDef,RCFB32ReadView,12,0][MTransformGet,RCFB32ReadView,0]
            [MVarSet,RCFB32ReadView,9,[CanvasZoomGet]]
            [MVarSet,RCFB32ReadView,10,[CanvasPanGetH]][MVarSet,RCFB32ReadView,11,[CanvasPanGetV]]
            [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
                [SubToolSelect,cbIndex][RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ReadName]
                [MemReadString,FB32LegacyNames,cbLegacyName,cbIndex*1024,0]
                [If,([StrLength,cbLegacyName]!=[StrLength,cbTrackName])||([StrFind,cbLegacyName,cbTrackName]!=0)||([SubToolGetID,cbIndex]!=[MVarGet,FB32LegacyState,2+cbIndex]),
                    [VarSet,cbTrackValid,0][LoopExit]
                ]
            ,cbIndex]
            [SubToolSelect,cbLegacySelected]
            [MTransformSet,RCFB32ReadView,0][CanvasZoomSet,[MVarGet,RCFB32ReadView,9]]
            [CanvasPanSet,[MVarGet,RCFB32ReadView,10],[MVarGet,RCFB32ReadView,11]]
            [MemDelete,RCFB32ReadView]
        ]
        [If,cbTrackValid==0,
            [MessageOK,"The untracked legacy Tool/order/names changed during review. Restore the original unchanged Tool, or re-import the bank and restart review. No positional remapping was attempted.","Camera Bank Fast"][Exit]
        ]
    ]
]

[RoutineDef,RC_CBF_FullCheck,
    [VarSet,cbTrackValid,1][VarSet,cbTrackError,""]
    [VarSet,cbPendingFirst,0]
    [VarSet,cbTrackPrefix,[StrMerge,"CB",[MVarGet,FB25Data,8],[MVarGet,FB25Data,9],"G"]]
    [VarSet,cbOldSelected,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]]
    [If,([SubToolGetCount]<1)||([SubToolGetCount]>1000),
        [VarSet,cbTrackValid,0][VarSet,cbTrackError,"A tracked model must have 1 to 1000 SubTools."]
    ]
    [Loop,1000,[VarSet,cbTrackSeen(cbIndex),0],cbIndex]
    [If,cbTrackValid==1,
        [If,[MemGetSize,RCFB32ReadView]>0,[MemDelete,RCFB32ReadView]]
        [MVarDef,RCFB32ReadView,12,0][MTransformGet,RCFB32ReadView,0]
        [MVarSet,RCFB32ReadView,9,[CanvasZoomGet]]
        [MVarSet,RCFB32ReadView,10,[CanvasPanGetH]][MVarSet,RCFB32ReadView,11,[CanvasPanGetV]]
        [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
            [SubToolSelect,cbIndex][RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ReadName]
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_ParseTag,cbTrackName]
            [If,(cbParsedGroup<1)||(cbParsedGroup>[MVarGet,FB25Data,25745]),
                [VarSet,cbAliasOK,0]
                [If,(cbIndex==0)&&(cbTagCount==0),
                    [VarSet,cbAliasTool,[ToolGetActiveIndex]]
                    [VarSet,cbAliasPath,[ToolGetPath,cbAliasTool]]
                    [VarSet,cbAliasName,[FileNameExtract,cbAliasPath,6]]
                    [If,([StrLength,cbAliasName]>0)&&([StrLength,cbAliasName]==[StrLength,cbTrackName]),
                        [If,[StrFind,cbAliasName,cbTrackName]==0,[VarSet,cbAliasOK,1]]
                    ]
                ]
                [If,cbAliasOK==1,
                    [VarSet,cbPendingFirst,1][VarSet,cbTrackGroups(0),0]
                ,
                    [VarSet,cbTrackValid,0]
                    [VarSet,cbTrackError,"A SubTool has no valid identifier for this bank. Open the matching ZTL/ZPR. Only a first-SubTool filename alias with a verified native-ID match can be recovered."]
                    [LoopExit]
                ]
            ,
                [VarSet,cbTrackGroups(cbIndex),cbParsedGroup]
                [VarSet,cbTrackSeen(cbParsedGroup-1),1]
            ]
        ,cbIndex]
        [SubToolSelect,cbOldSelected]
        [MTransformSet,RCFB32ReadView,0][CanvasZoomSet,[MVarGet,RCFB32ReadView,9]]
        [CanvasPanSet,[MVarGet,RCFB32ReadView,10],[MVarGet,RCFB32ReadView,11]]
        [MemDelete,RCFB32ReadView]
    ]
    [If,(cbTrackValid==1)&&(cbPendingFirst==1),
        [RoutineCall,RC_CB321_ResolveFirstID]
        [If,cbFirstIdGroup>0,
            [VarSet,cbTrackGroups(0),cbFirstIdGroup]
            [VarSet,cbTrackSeen(cbFirstIdGroup-1),1]
        ,
            [VarSet,cbTrackValid,0]
            [VarSet,cbTrackError,"The first SubTool lost its name identifier and this bank has no unambiguous native-ID match. For an older bank, import it once on the matching marked Tool in 3.2.1 and export again."]
        ]
    ]
    [VarSet,cbUsedLow,0][VarSet,cbUsedHigh,0]
    [Loop,25,
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,20+(cbSlot*20)]==1,
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_Bit,cbSlot]
            [If,cbTrackHalf==0,[VarSet,cbUsedLow,cbUsedLow+cbTrackBit],[VarSet,cbUsedHigh,cbUsedHigh+cbTrackBit]]
        ]
    ,cbSlot]
    [If,cbTrackValid==1,
        [Loop,[MVarGet,FB25Data,25745],
            [If,cbTrackSeen(cbGroupIndex)==0,
                [VarSet,cbMissingLow,([MVarGet,FB25Data,25746+(cbGroupIndex*2)]&cbUsedLow)]
                [VarSet,cbMissingHigh,([MVarGet,FB25Data,25747+(cbGroupIndex*2)]&cbUsedHigh)]
                [If,(cbMissingLow!=0)||(cbMissingHigh!=0),
                    [VarSet,cbEquivalent,0]
                    [Loop,[MVarGet,FB25Data,25745],
                        [If,cbTrackSeen(cbOtherGroup)==1,
                            [If,(([MVarGet,FB25Data,25746+(cbOtherGroup*2)]&cbUsedLow)==cbMissingLow)&&(([MVarGet,FB25Data,25747+(cbOtherGroup*2)]&cbUsedHigh)==cbMissingHigh),
                                [VarSet,cbEquivalent,1][LoopExit]
                            ]
                        ]
                    ,cbOtherGroup]
                    [If,cbEquivalent==0,
                        [VarSet,cbTrackValid,0]
                        [VarSet,cbTrackError,"A visibility group used by a stored camera is missing. Restore the complete model and merge only parts with identical visibility in ALL stored cameras."]
                    ]
                ]
            ]
        ,cbGroupIndex]
    ]
]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_RequireVisibility,
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB325_RequireFastReady]
    [If,([MemGetSize,FB32RenameState]>0)||([MemGetSize,FB32OriginalBank]>0),
        [MessageOK,"An identifier update was interrupted. Use a Camera Bank button on the same Tool to recover it before recalling or rendering.","Camera Bank Fast"][Exit]
    ]
    [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,7]==1,
        [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_CheckTracked]
        [If,cbTrackValid==0,[MessageOK,cbTrackError,"Camera Bank Fast"][Exit]]
    ,
        [VarSet,cbSavedCount,[MVarGet,FB25Data,520+(cbSlot*1001)]]
        [If,(cbSavedCount>0)&&(cbSavedCount!=[SubToolGetCount]),
            [MessageOK,"This camera has positional visibility only. Use its original unmerged Tool and review/UPDATE ACTIVE for every camera before reordering or merging. Tracking will complete automatically.","Camera Bank Fast"][Exit]
        ]
        [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_CheckLegacyOrder]
        [If,[MemGetSize,FB32LegacyState]==0,
            [If,[MessageYesNo,"This bank has no name ancestry. Continue ONLY on its ORIGINAL unmerged Tool with the original SubTool order. Equal counts cannot prove identity. Review this view, then UPDATE ACTIVE. Continue?","Camera Bank Fast"]!=1,[Exit]]
        ]
    ]
,cbSlot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_VisibleNow,
    [VarSet,cbTrackVisible,0]
    [If,([SubToolGetStatus,cbIndex]&1)!=0,[VarSet,cbTrackVisible,1]]
    [VarSet,cbFolder,[SubToolGetFolderIndex,cbIndex]]
    [If,cbFolder>=0,
        [If,([SubToolGetStatus,cbFolder]&2)==0,[VarSet,cbTrackVisible,0]]
    ]
    [If,[IExists,"Transform:Solo"],
        [If,[IGet,"Transform:Solo"]==1,[VarSet,cbTrackVisible,0]]
    ]
    [If,cbIndex==[SubToolGetActiveIndex],[VarSet,cbTrackVisible,1]]
,cbIndex]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_RestoreEffective,
    [VarSet,cbOldSelected,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]][VarSet,cbFirstVisible,-1]
    [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,7]==1,
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_GroupVisible,cbTrackGroups(cbIndex),cbSlot]
        ,
            [VarSet,cbTrackVisible,0]
            [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,521+(cbSlot*1001)+cbIndex]&4)!=0,[VarSet,cbTrackVisible,1]]
        ]
        [VarSet,cbTrackEye(cbIndex),cbTrackVisible]
        [If,(cbTrackVisible==1)&&(cbFirstVisible<0),[VarSet,cbFirstVisible,cbIndex]]
    ,cbIndex]
    [If,cbFirstVisible<0,[MessageOK,"No visible part remains for this camera.","Camera Bank Fast"][Exit]]
    [If,cbTrackEye(cbOldSelected)==1,[VarSet,cbFirstVisible,cbOldSelected]]
    [If,[IExists,"Transform:Solo"],[IUnPress,"Transform:Solo"]]
    [SubToolSelect,cbFirstVisible]
    [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
        [VarSet,cbStatus,[SubToolGetStatus,cbIndex]]
        [SubToolSetStatus,cbIndex,(cbStatus-(cbStatus&3))+cbTrackEye(cbIndex)+2]
    ,cbIndex]
    [IUpdate,1,1]
,cbSlot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB32_RestoreLegacyVisualState,
    [VarSet,visBase,
        520 + (slot * 1001)
    ]
    [VarSet,savedCount,
        [MVarGet,FB25Data,visBase]
    ]
    [VarSet,currentCount,
        [SubToolGetCount]
    ]
    [If,
        (savedCount > 0)
        &&
        (savedCount == currentCount),
        [VarSet,st,0]
        [Loop,savedCount,
            [VarSet,savedState,
                [MVarGet,
                    FB25Data,
                    visBase + 1 + st
                ]
            ]
            [VarSet,savedEye,
                (savedState & 0x01)
            ]
            [VarSet,currentStatus,
                [SubToolGetStatus,st]
            ]
            [VarSet,currentEye,
                (currentStatus & 0x01)
            ]
            [SubToolSetStatus,
                st,
                (currentStatus - currentEye) + savedEye
            ]
            [VarInc,st]
        ]
        [VarSet,st,0]
        [Loop,savedCount,
            [VarSet,savedState,
                [MVarGet,
                    FB25Data,
                    visBase + 1 + st
                ]
            ]
            [VarSet,savedFolderEye,
                (savedState & 0x02)
            ]
            [VarSet,currentStatus,
                [SubToolGetStatus,st]
            ]
            [VarSet,currentFolderEye,
                (currentStatus & 0x02)
            ]
            [SubToolSetStatus,
                st,
                (currentStatus - currentFolderEye) + savedFolderEye
            ]
            [VarInc,st]
        ]
        [IUpdate,1,1]
    ]
,slot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB31_Require3D,
    [If,([IsEnabled,"Transform:Edit"]==0)||([IGet,"Transform:Edit"]==0),
        [MessageOK,"No live 3D model is in Edit mode. Select your Tool, draw it on the canvas and press T (Edit), then try again. The camera has not been changed.","Camera Bank Fast"]
        [Exit]
    ]
    [If,[SubToolGetCount]<1,
        [MessageOK,"No editable mesh was found. If this is a primitive or ZSphere, make a PolyMesh3D/adaptive skin first, then store the camera. Automatic conversion is avoided to preserve your Tool.","Camera Bank Fast"]
        [Exit]
    ]
]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB30_LensPaths,
    [VarSet,cbFovPath,""]
    [VarSet,cbUniversalPath,""]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Angle Of View"],[VarSet,cbFovPath,"Draw:Angle Of View"]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Field of View"],[VarSet,cbFovPath,"Draw:Field of View"]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Field Of View(deg)"],[VarSet,cbFovPath,"Draw:Field Of View(deg)"]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Universal Camera"],[VarSet,cbUniversalPath,"Draw:Universal Camera"]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:UniversalCamera"],[VarSet,cbUniversalPath,"Draw:UniversalCamera"]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Camera Mode"],[VarSet,cbUniversalPath,"Draw:Camera Mode"]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Camera"],[VarSet,cbUniversalPath,"Draw:Camera"]]
    [If,[StrLength,cbUniversalPath]>0,
        [If,[IGet,[Var,cbUniversalPath]]==0,
            [If,[IExists,"Draw:Angle Of View"],[VarSet,cbFovPath,"Draw:Angle Of View"]]
        ]
    ]
]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB30_Resize,
    [If,(cbW>0)&&(cbH>0),
        [If,(cbW>[IGetMax,"Document:Width"])||(cbH>[IGetMax,"Document:Height"]),
            [MessageOK,"Saved canvas size exceeds this ZBrush version's limits.","Camera Bank Fast"]
            [Exit]
        ]
        [If,(cbW!=[IGet,"Document:Width"])||(cbH!=[IGet,"Document:Height"]),
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB31_Require3D]
            [VarSet,cbPro,[IGet,"Document:Pro"]]
            [If,[IExists,"Preferences:LightBox:LightBox"],
                [ISet,"Preferences:LightBox:LightBox",0]
            ]
            [VarSet,cbThumbnail,0]
            [If,[IExists,"Preferences:Thumbnail:T.Thumbnail"],
                [VarSet,cbThumbnail,[IGet,"Preferences:Thumbnail:T.Thumbnail"]]
                [IUnPress,"Preferences:Thumbnail:T.Thumbnail"]
            ]
            [IUnPress,"Transform:Edit"]
            [IPress,"Layer:Clear"]
            [IUnPress,"Document:Pro"]
            [ISet,"Document:Width",cbW]
            [ISet,"Document:Height",cbH]
            [IKeyPress,13,[IPress,"Document:Resize"]]
            [ISet,"Document:Pro",cbPro]
            [IPress,"Transform:Draw Pointer"]
            [CanvasClick,10,10,20,20]
            [IPress,"Transform:Edit"]
            [IUpdate,1,1]
            [If,[IExists,"Preferences:Thumbnail:T.Thumbnail"],
                [ISet,"Preferences:Thumbnail:T.Thumbnail",cbThumbnail]
            ]
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB31_Require3D]
        ]
    ]
,cbW,cbH]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB30_RestoreLens,
    [VarSet,cbBase,20 + (cbSlot*20)]
    [VarSet,cbExtra,25545 + (cbSlot*8)]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB30_LensPaths]
    [If,[StrLength,cbUniversalPath]>0,
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+2]>=0,[ISet,[Var,cbUniversalPath],[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+2]]]
    ]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB30_LensPaths]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Perspective"],[IPress,"Draw:Perspective"]]
    [If,[IsEnabled,"Draw:Crop Factor"],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+5]>0,[ISet,"Draw:Crop Factor",[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+5]]]
    ]
    [If,[IsEnabled,"Draw:Horizontal"],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+6]==1,[IPress,"Draw:Horizontal"]]
    ]
    [If,[IsEnabled,"Draw:Vertical"],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+7]==1,[IPress,"Draw:Vertical"]]
    ]
    [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbBase+15]==1,
        [If,[IsEnabled,"Draw:Focal Length(mm)"],[ISet,"Draw:Focal Length(mm)",[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbBase+11]]]
    ]
    [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbBase+15]==2,
        [If,[IExists,"Draw:Focal Length"],
            [If,[IsEnabled,"Draw:Focal Length"],[ISet,"Draw:Focal Length",[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbBase+11]]]
        ]
    ]
    [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+1]==1)&&([StrLength,cbFovPath]>0),
        [ISet,[Var,cbFovPath],[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra]]
    ]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Align To Object"],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+3]>=0,[ISet,"Draw:Align To Object",[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+3]]]
    ]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Auto Adjust Distance"],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+4]>=0,[ISet,"Draw:Auto Adjust Distance",[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbExtra+4]]]
    ]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Perspective"],
        [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbBase+10]>=0,[ISet,"Draw:Perspective",[MVarGet,FB25Data,cbBase+10]]]
    ]
,cbSlot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB29_LoadSlot,
    [VarSet,cbFastStoreCheck,0]
    
    [VarSet,base,20+(slot*20)]
    [If,[MVarGet,FB25Data,base]!=1,[Exit]]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB31_Require3D]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_RequireVisibility,slot]
    [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,base+18]==0)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,25546+(slot*8)]==0),
        [Loop,6,[MVarSet,FB25Data,25547+(slot*8)+cbUnknown,-1],cbUnknown]
    ]
    [VarSet,cbLock,0]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Lock Camera"],
        [VarSet,cbLock,[IGet,"Draw:Lock Camera"]]
        [IUnPress,"Draw:Lock Camera"]
    ]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB30_Resize,[MVarGet,FB25Data,base+18],[MVarGet,FB25Data,base+19]]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB30_RestoreLens,slot]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB29_RestoreVisualState,slot]
    [MTransformSet,FB25Data,base+1]
    [CanvasZoomSet,[MVarGet,FB25Data,base+12]]
    [CanvasPanSet,[MVarGet,FB25Data,base+13],[MVarGet,FB25Data,base+14]]
    [If,[IExists,"Draw:Lock Camera"],[ISet,"Draw:Lock Camera",cbLock]]
    [MVarSet,FB25Data,5,slot+1]
    [IUpdate,2,1]
,slot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB29_RestoreVisualState,
    [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,7]==1)||([MVarGet,FB25Data,27746+slot]>0),
        [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_RestoreEffective,slot]
    ,
        [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_RestoreLegacyVisualState,slot]
    ]
,slot]

[RoutineDef,RC_CB325_RequireFastReady,
    [If,(([MemGetSize,FBFTxn]>0)||([MemGetSize,FBFOriginal]>0))||(([MemGetSize,FB32RenameState]>0)||([MemGetSize,FB32OriginalBank]>0)),
        [MessageOK,"A Camera Bank Fast update is pending. Press a Fast camera button on the same Tool to finish recovery before exporting.","Camera Bank Fast"][Exit]
    ]
]



// Render Capture 3.2.5 - Windows / ZBrush 2023.2.1 target.
// Exactly three public buttons. Reads standalone Camera Bank Fast data v9 via FB25Data.
// 3.2.0: both phases share each camera folder. See Development/VERIFICATION_3.2.0.md.
// Source verification and native limits: Development/RENDER_3.2.0_RESULT.md.
[ISubPalette,"ZPlugin:Render Capture"]
[VarDef,rcRoot,""]
[VarDef,rcDll,""]
[VarDef,rcError,""]
[VarDef,rcThor,-1]
[VarDef,rcNormal,-1]
[VarDef,rcDouble,-1]
[VarDef,rcMetal,-1]
[VarDef,rcCameraCount,0]
[VarDef,rcLabel,""]
[VarDef,rcPassCount,0]
[VarDef,rcSlot,0]
[VarDef,rcOutput,""]
[VarDef,rcPassIDs(7),0]
[VarDef,rcPassNames(7),""]
[VarDef,rcRenderModePaths(4),""]
[VarSet,rcRenderModePaths(0),"Render:Preview"]
[VarSet,rcRenderModePaths(1),"Render:Best"]
[VarSet,rcRenderModePaths(2),"Render:Fast"]
[VarSet,rcRenderModePaths(3),"Render:Flat"]

// A recovery snapshot survives Escape and ZScript switching in this session.
// Do not restore flags into a different Tool / changed subtool list.
[RoutineDef,RC_Restore,
    [If,[MemGetSize,RC30Recovery]>0,
        [If,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,0]==1,
            [VarSet,rcCanRestore,1]
            [If,[SubToolGetCount]!=[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,2],[VarSet,rcCanRestore,0]]
            [If,rcCanRestore==1,
                [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
                    [If,[SubToolGetID,rcRestoreIndex]!=[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,32+(rcRestoreIndex*3)],
                        [VarSet,rcCanRestore,0]
                    ]
                ,rcRestoreIndex]
            ]
            [If,rcCanRestore==0,
                [MessageOK,"An interrupted render has saved display settings. Select the same Tool with the same SubTools, then press a Render Capture button to restore them.","Render Capture"]
                [Exit]
            ]
            [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
                [SubToolSelect,rcRestoreIndex]
                [If,[IsEnabled,"Tool:Polypaint:Colorize"],
                    [ISet,"Tool:Polypaint:Colorize",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,33+(rcRestoreIndex*3)]]
                ]
                [If,[IsEnabled,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On"],
                    [ISet,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,34+(rcRestoreIndex*3)]]
                ]
            ,rcRestoreIndex]
            [SubToolSelect,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,1]]
            [ISet,"Material:ItemInfo",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,3]]
            [IColorSet,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,4],[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,5],[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,6]]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:Shadows",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,7]]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:AOcclusion",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,8]]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:Sss",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,9]]
            [ISet,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Reuse Existing Maps",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,10]]
            [If,[IExists,"Transform:Solo"],
                [If,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,16]>=0,[ISet,"Transform:Solo",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,16]]]
            ]
            [RoutineCall,RC_RestoreSSSLight]
            [IPress,rcRenderModePaths([MVarGet,RC30Recovery,11])]
            [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,0,0]
            [IUpdate,1,1]
        ]
    ]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_Fail,
    [RoutineCall,RC_Restore]
    [MessageOK,rcMessage,"Render Capture"]
    [Exit]
,rcMessage]
[RoutineDef,RC_Snapshot,
    [If,[MemGetSize,RC30Recovery]>0,[MemDelete,RC30Recovery]]
    [MVarDef,RC30Recovery,3032,0]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,1,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,2,[SubToolGetCount]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,3,[IGet,"Material:ItemInfo"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,4,[IGet,"Color:R"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,5,[IGet,"Color:G"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,6,[IGet,"Color:B"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,7,[IGet,"Render:Render Properties:Shadows"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,8,[IGet,"Render:Render Properties:AOcclusion"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,9,[IGet,"Render:Render Properties:Sss"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,10,[IGet,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Reuse Existing Maps"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,16,-1]
    [If,[IExists,"Transform:Solo"],[MVarSet,RC30Recovery,16,[IGet,"Transform:Solo"]]]
    [Loop,4,
        [If,[IGet,rcRenderModePaths(rcMode)]==1,[MVarSet,RC30Recovery,11,rcMode]]
    ,rcMode]
    [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
        [SubToolSelect,rcSaveIndex]
        [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,32+(rcSaveIndex*3),[SubToolGetID,rcSaveIndex]]
        [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,33+(rcSaveIndex*3),[IGet,"Tool:Polypaint:Colorize"]]
        [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,34+(rcSaveIndex*3),[IGet,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On"]]
    ,rcSaveIndex]
    [SubToolSelect,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,1]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,0,1]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_PrepareSSSLight,
    // BPR needs SSS on one of lights 2-8, even when that light is OFF.
    // Light:Save crashed in both owner activity logs. Snapshot only the fields
    // we change in persistent session memory; never serialize/load the rig.
    [VarSet,rcFirstLight,[IGetID,"Light:Light Switch"]]
    [VarSet,rcSecondLight,rcFirstLight+1]
    [If,[IExists,[Var,rcSecondLight]]==0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Second light selector is unavailable."]]
    [VarSet,rcLightTitle,[IGetTitle,[Var,rcSecondLight],1]]
    [If,[StrFind,"Light:Light Switch",rcLightTitle]!=0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Unexpected second light selector."]]
    [VarSet,rcLightOn,[IGet,[Var,rcSecondLight]]]
    [IClick,[Var,rcSecondLight]]
    [ISet,[Var,rcSecondLight],rcLightOn]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,13,rcSecondLight]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,14,rcLightOn]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,15,[IGet,"Light:Lights Properties:Sss"]]
    [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,12,1]
    [ISet,"Light:Lights Properties:Sss",1]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_RestoreSSSLight,
    [If,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,12]==1,
        [VarSet,rcRestoreLight,[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,13]]
        [IClick,[Var,rcRestoreLight]]
        [ISet,[Var,rcRestoreLight],[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,14]]
        [ISet,"Light:Lights Properties:Sss",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,15]]
        [MVarSet,RC30Recovery,12,0]
    ]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_CheckBank,
    [If,[MemGetSize,FB25Data]!=123088,
        [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Open Camera Bank Fast, then import or store your cameras. Its standalone plugin must be loaded."]
    ]
    [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,0]!=252523)||([MVarGet,FB25Data,1]!=9)||([MVarGet,FB25Data,2]!=25),
        [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Unsupported Camera Bank Fast data. Expected data v9."]
    ]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CB325_RequireFastReady]
    [If,[SubToolGetCount]>1000,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Maximum supported SubTools: 1000."]]
    [VarSet,rcCameraCount,0]
    [Loop,25,
        [VarSet,rcCheckBase,20+(rcCheckSlot*20)]
        [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase]==1)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase+16]==1),
            [VarInc,rcCameraCount]
        ]
    ,rcCheckSlot]
    [If,rcCameraCount==0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Enable at least one stored camera (orange) in Camera Bank Fast."]]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_Preflight,
    [RoutineCall,RC_CheckBank]
    [If,([IsEnabled,"Transform:Edit"]==0)||([IGet,"Transform:Edit"]==0),[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"No live 3D model is in Edit mode. Select and draw the Tool, press T, then try again."]]
    [If,[SubToolGetCount]<1,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"No editable mesh was found. Convert a primitive/ZSphere to PolyMesh3D or adaptive skin before rendering."]]
    [Loop,25,
        [VarSet,rcCheckBase,20+(rcCheckSlot*20)]
        [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase]==1)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase+16]==1),
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB32_RequireVisibility,rcCheckSlot]
            [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase+18]<=0)||([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase+19]<=0),
                [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Camera ",rcCheckSlot+1," has no saved canvas size. Recall it, set the correct document size and lens, then press UPDATE ACTIVE."]]
            ]
            [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase+18]>[IGetMax,"Document:Width"])||([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcCheckBase+19]>[IGetMax,"Document:Height"]),
                [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"A camera's resolution exceeds the current document size limits."]
            ]
        ]
    ,rcCheckSlot]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_CheckDLL,
    [VarSet,rcDll,[FileNameResolvePath,"RenderCaptureData/ZFileUtils64.dll"]]
    [If,[FileExists,[Var,rcDll]]==0,
        [VarSet,rcDll,[FileNameResolvePath,"ZFileUtils64.dll"]]
    ]
    [If,[FileExists,[Var,rcDll]]==0,
        [VarSet,rcDll,[FileNameResolvePath,"ZBRUSH_ZSTARTUP/ZPlugs64/MacroData/ZFileUtils64.dll"]]
    ]
    [If,[FileExists,[Var,rcDll]]==0,
        [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"ZFileUtils64.dll is missing. Run INSTALAR.cmd to copy it from your ZBrush installation."]
    ]
    [If,[FileExecute,[Var,rcDll],"Version"]<8,
        [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"ZFileUtils v8 or newer is required."]
    ]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_Folder,
    [If,[FileExecute,[Var,rcDll],"FolderExists",rcFolderPath]==0,
        [VarSet,rcFolderResult,[FileExecute,[Var,rcDll],"MakeFolder",rcFolderPath]]
        [If,rcFolderResult!=0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Cannot create folder: ",rcFolderPath]]]
    ]
,rcFolderPath]
[RoutineDef,RC_Label,
    [If,rcCamera<10,[VarSet,rcLabel,[StrMerge,"0",rcCamera]],[VarSet,rcLabel,[StrMerge,"",rcCamera]]]
,rcCamera]
[RoutineDef,RC_GetRoot,
    [VarSet,rcRoot,""]
    [If,[MemGetSize,RC30Root]>0,[MemReadString,RC30Root,rcRoot,0,1]]
    // Discard pre-3.2.2 session roots; only the fixed output folder is valid.
    [If,[StrLength,rcRoot]>0,
        [If,[StrLength,rcRoot]<8,[VarSet,rcRoot,""],
            [VarSet,rcTail,[StrLower,[StrExtract,rcRoot,[StrLength,rcRoot]-8,[StrLength,rcRoot]-1]]]
            [If,([StrFind,"/zpass_1",rcTail]!=0)&&([StrFind,"\zpass_1",rcTail]!=0),[VarSet,rcRoot,""]]
        ]
    ]
    [If,[StrLength,rcRoot]==0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Press 1 - CREATE FOLDERS first."]]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CheckDLL]
    [If,[FileExecute,[Var,rcDll],"FolderExists",rcRoot]==0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Output folder no longer exists. Press 1 - CREATE FOLDERS."]]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_CreateFolders,
    [RoutineCall,RC_Restore]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CheckBank]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CheckDLL]
    [If,[MemGetSize,RC30Choose]>0,[MemDelete,RC30Choose]]
    [MemCreate,RC30Choose,1024,0]
    [VarSet,rcChoice,[FileExecute,[Var,rcDll],"ChooseFolder",,,RC30Choose]]
    [If,rcChoice!=0,[MemDelete,RC30Choose][Exit]]
    [VarSet,rcChosenRoot,""]
    [MemReadString,RC30Choose,rcChosenRoot,0,1]
    [MemDelete,RC30Choose]
    [If,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]==0,[Exit]]
    [If,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]>180,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,"Choose a shorter output path (maximum 180 characters)."]]
    // Accept either the parent directory or ZPass_1 itself, including a trailing separator.
    [Loop,1024,
        [If,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]<2,[LoopExit]]
        [VarSet,rcLast,[StrToAsc,rcChosenRoot,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]-1]]
        [If,(rcLast!=47)&&(rcLast!=92),[LoopExit]]
        [VarSet,rcChosenRoot,[StrExtract,rcChosenRoot,0,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]-2]]
    ]
    [VarSet,rcRoot,[StrMerge,rcChosenRoot,"/ZPass_1"]]
    [If,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]>=7,
        [VarSet,rcTail,[StrLower,[StrExtract,rcChosenRoot,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]-7,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]-1]]]
        [If,[StrFind,"zpass_1",rcTail]==0,
            [If,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]==7,[VarSet,rcRoot,rcChosenRoot],
                [VarSet,rcLast,[StrToAsc,rcChosenRoot,[StrLength,rcChosenRoot]-8]]
                [If,(rcLast==47)||(rcLast==92),[VarSet,rcRoot,rcChosenRoot]]
            ]
        ]
    ]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Folder,rcRoot]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Folder,[StrMerge,rcRoot,"/Screenshots"]]
    [Loop,25,
        [VarSet,rcBase,20+(rcSlot*20)]
        [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase]==1)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase+16]==1),
            [RoutineCall,RC_Label,rcSlot+1]
            [RoutineCall,RC_Folder,[StrMerge,rcRoot,"/",rcLabel]]
        ]
    ,rcSlot]
    [If,[MemGetSize,RC30Root]>0,[MemDelete,RC30Root]]
    [MemCreate,RC30Root,1024,0]
    [MemWriteString,RC30Root,rcRoot,0]
    [MessageOK,[StrMerge,"Folders ready: ",rcRoot,". Use buttons 2 and 3 for this session."],"Render Capture"]
]
// Name matching uses the complete material name, not fixed material slot IDs.
// Prefer exact Basic Thor / DoubleShade, then the first substring match.
[RoutineDef,RC_MaterialCandidate,
    [If,[IExists,[Var,rcCandidateID]],
        [VarSet,rcCandidatePath,[IGetTitle,[Var,rcCandidateID],1]]
        [If,[StrFind,"Material:",[Var,rcCandidatePath]]==0,
            [VarSet,rcCandidateName,[IGetTitle,[Var,rcCandidateID]]]
            [If,([StrFind,"Basic Thor",[Var,rcCandidateName]]>=0)&&(rcThor<0),[VarSet,rcThor,rcCandidateID]]
            [If,([StrFind,"DoubleShade",[Var,rcCandidateName]]>=0)&&(rcDouble<0),[VarSet,rcDouble,rcCandidateID]]
            [If,([StrLength,[Var,rcCandidateName]]==10)&&([StrFind,"Basic Thor",[Var,rcCandidateName]]==0),[VarSet,rcThor,rcCandidateID]]
            [If,([StrLength,[Var,rcCandidateName]]==11)&&([StrFind,"DoubleShade",[Var,rcCandidateName]]==0),[VarSet,rcDouble,rcCandidateID]]
            [If,([StrLength,[Var,rcCandidateName]]==12)&&([StrFind,"NormalRGBMat",[Var,rcCandidateName]]==0),[VarSet,rcNormal,rcCandidateID]]
            [If,([StrLength,[Var,rcCandidateName]]==8)&&([StrFind,"Metal 11",[Var,rcCandidateName]]==0),[VarSet,rcMetal,rcCandidateID]]
        ]
    ]
,rcCandidateID]
[RoutineDef,RC_Materials,
    [VarSet,rcThor,-1][VarSet,rcNormal,-1][VarSet,rcDouble,-1][VarSet,rcMetal,-1]
    // Read material button titles without selecting unrelated materials.
    // This avoids Redshift's selection dialog and preview-render side effects.
    [If,[IExists,"Material:Basic Thor"],[RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,[IGetID,"Material:Basic Thor"]]]
    [If,[IExists,"Material:Basic Thor (1)"],[RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,[IGetID,"Material:Basic Thor (1)"]]]
    [If,[IExists,"Material:NormalRGBMat"],[RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,[IGetID,"Material:NormalRGBMat"]]]
    [If,[IExists,"Material:DoubleShade"],[RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,[IGetID,"Material:DoubleShade"]]]
    [If,[IExists,"Material:DoubleShade1"],[RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,[IGetID,"Material:DoubleShade1"]]]
    [If,[IExists,"Material:Metal 11"],[RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,[IGetID,"Material:Metal 11"]]]
    [If,((rcThor<0)||(rcNormal<0))||((rcDouble<0)||(rcMetal<0)),
        [IFreeze,
            [Loop,65536,
                [RoutineCall,RC_MaterialCandidate,rcScanID]
                [If,((rcThor>=0)&&(rcNormal>=0))&&((rcDouble>=0)&&(rcMetal>=0)),[LoopExit]]
            ,rcScanID]
        ]
    ]
    [VarSet,rcMissing,""]
    [If,rcThor<0,[VarSet,rcMissing,[StrMerge,rcMissing," Basic Thor;"]]]
    [If,rcNormal<0,[VarSet,rcMissing,[StrMerge,rcMissing," NormalRGBMat;"]]]
    [If,rcDouble<0,[VarSet,rcMissing,[StrMerge,rcMissing," DoubleShade;"]]]
    [If,rcMetal<0,[VarSet,rcMissing,[StrMerge,rcMissing," Metal 11;"]]]
    [If,[StrLength,rcMissing]>0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Load the missing materials into ZBrush first:",rcMissing]]]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_Polypaint,
    [VarSet,rcSelected,[SubToolGetActiveIndex]]
    [Loop,[SubToolGetCount],
        [SubToolSelect,rcPPIndex]
        [If,[IsEnabled,"Tool:Polypaint:Colorize"],[ISet,"Tool:Polypaint:Colorize",rcPP*[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,33+(rcPPIndex*3)]]]
        [If,rcPP==0,
            [If,[IsEnabled,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On"],[IUnPress,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On"]]
        ,
            [If,[IsEnabled,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On"],
                [ISet,"Tool:Texture Map:Texture On",[MVarGet,RC30Recovery,34+(rcPPIndex*3)]]
            ]
        ]
    ,rcPPIndex]
    [SubToolSelect,rcSelected]
,rcPP]
[RoutineDef,RC_OutputFolder,
    [RoutineCall,RC_Label,rcSlot+1]
    [VarSet,rcOutput,[StrMerge,rcRoot,"/",rcLabel]]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Folder,rcOutput]
]
// Prepare enabled camera folders before changing display state or rendering.
// Matching outputs are replaced silently by RC_Export / RC_CopyScreenshot.
[RoutineDef,RC_CheckOutput,
    [Loop,25,
        [VarSet,rcBase,20+(rcSlot*20)]
        [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase]==1)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase+16]==1),
            [RoutineCall,RC_OutputFolder]
        ]
    ,rcSlot]
,rcCheckScreenshots]
[RoutineDef,RC_Export,
    [If,[FileExists,rcOutputFile]>0,
        [If,[FileDelete,rcOutputFile]!=0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Cannot replace: ",rcOutputFile]]]
    ]
    [FileNameSetNext,[Var,rcOutputFile]]
    [IPress,[Var,rcExportID]]
    [IUpdate,1,1]
    [If,[FileExists,[Var,rcOutputFile]]==0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Export failed: ",rcOutputFile]]]
,rcExportID,rcOutputFile]
[RoutineDef,RC_CopyScreenshot,
    [VarSet,rcShotFile,[StrMerge,rcRoot,"/Screenshots/",rcLabel,".png"]]
    // FileCopyTo copies the exported PNG bytes; do not render or export again.
    [If,[FileExists,rcShotFile]>0,
        [If,[FileDelete,rcShotFile]!=0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Cannot replace: ",rcShotFile]]]
    ]
    [If,[MemGetSize,RC31CopyPath]>0,[MemDelete,RC31CopyPath]]
    [MemCreate,RC31CopyPath,1024,0]
    [MemWriteString,RC31CopyPath,rcShotFile,0]
    [VarSet,rcCopyResult,[FileExecute,[Var,rcDll],"FileCopyTo",[StrMerge,rcOutput,"/Z document.png"],,RC31CopyPath]]
    [MemDelete,RC31CopyPath]
    [If,(rcCopyResult!=0)||([FileExists,rcShotFile]==0),
        [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Screenshot copy failed: ",rcShotFile]]
    ]
]
[RoutineDef,RC_NonBPR,
    [RoutineCall,RC_Restore]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Preflight]
    [RoutineCall,RC_GetRoot]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Materials]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Folder,[StrMerge,rcRoot,"/Screenshots"]]
    [VarSet,rcPassCount,4]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(0),"Z document.png"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(1),"Normal.png"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(2),"Double.png"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(3),"Metal.png"]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CheckOutput,1]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Snapshot]
    [Loop,25,
        [VarSet,rcBase,20+(rcSlot*20)]
        [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase]==1)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase+16]==1),
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB29_LoadSlot,rcSlot]
            [RoutineCall,RC_OutputFolder]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:Shadows",0]
            [IColorSet,255,255,255]
            // Preserve the original workflow: document uses each original Polypaint flag;
            // Normal / Double / Metal use Polypaint and texture display OFF.
            [RoutineCall,RC_Polypaint,1]
            [IPress,[Var,rcThor]]
            [IPress,"Render:Preview"][IUpdate,2,1]
            [NoteBar,[StrMerge,"Non BPR | Camera ",rcLabel],rcSlot/25]
            [RoutineCall,RC_Export,"Document:Export",[StrMerge,rcOutput,"/",rcPassNames(0)]]
            [RoutineCall,RC_CopyScreenshot]
            [RoutineCall,RC_Polypaint,0]
            [IPress,[Var,rcNormal]]
            [IPress,"Render:Preview"][IUpdate,2,1]
            [RoutineCall,RC_Export,"Document:Export",[StrMerge,rcOutput,"/",rcPassNames(1)]]
            [IPress,[Var,rcDouble]]
            [IPress,"Render:Preview"][IUpdate,2,1]
            [RoutineCall,RC_Export,"Document:Export",[StrMerge,rcOutput,"/",rcPassNames(2)]]
            [IPress,[Var,rcMetal]]
            [IPress,"Render:Preview"][IUpdate,2,1]
            [RoutineCall,RC_Export,"Document:Export",[StrMerge,rcOutput,"/",rcPassNames(3)]]
        ]
    ,rcSlot]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Restore]
    [NoteBar,"Non BPR complete",1]
    [MessageOK,[StrMerge,rcCameraCount," cameras: 4 PNG files + 1 Screenshots copy each. Output: ",rcRoot],"Render Capture"]
]
// Some ZBrush versions cannot address pass thumbnails by their recorded names.
// Numeric IDs are the documented ZBrushCentral fallback; validate their parent.
[RoutineDef,RC_ResolvePass,
    [VarSet,rcPassID,0]
    [If,[IExists,[Var,rcPassPath]],[VarSet,rcPassID,[IGetID,[Var,rcPassPath]]]]
    [If,rcPassID==0,
        [If,[IExists,[Var,rcFallback]],
            [VarSet,rcTitle,[StrLower,[IGetTitle,[Var,rcFallback],1]]]
            [If,([StrFind,"render",rcTitle]>=0)&&([StrFind,"bpr",rcTitle]>=0),[VarSet,rcPassID,rcFallback]]
        ]
    ]
    [If,rcPassID==0,[RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"Cannot locate BPR pass: ",rcPassPath]]]
    [VarSet,rcPassIDs(rcPassIndex),rcPassID]
,rcPassIndex,rcPassPath,rcFallback]
[RoutineDef,RC_BPR,
    [RoutineCall,RC_Restore]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Preflight]
    [RoutineCall,RC_GetRoot]
    [VarSet,rcPassCount,7]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(0),"_AO.psd"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(1),"_Composite.psd"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(2),"_Depth.psd"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(3),"_Mask.psd"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(4),"_Render.psd"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(5),"_Shadow.psd"]
    [VarSet,rcPassNames(6),"_SSS.psd"]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,0,"Render:BPR RenderPass:AmOc",2210]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,1,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Com",2206]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,2,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Dep",2208]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,3,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Mask",2211]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,4,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Img",2207]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,5,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Shdw",2209]
    [RoutineCall,RC_ResolvePass,6,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Sss",2315]
    [RoutineCall,RC_CheckOutput,0]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Snapshot]
    [IPress,"Render:Preview"]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Polypaint,1]
    [RoutineCall,RC_PrepareSSSLight]
    [Loop,25,
        [VarSet,rcBase,20+(rcSlot*20)]
        [If,([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase]==1)&&([MVarGet,FB25Data,rcBase+16]==1),
            [RoutineCall,RC_CB29_LoadSlot,rcSlot]
            [RoutineCall,RC_OutputFolder]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:Shadows",1]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:AOcclusion",1]
            [ISet,"Render:Render Properties:Sss",1]
            [ISet,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Reuse Existing Maps",0]
            [NoteBar,[StrMerge,"BPR | Camera ",rcLabel],rcSlot/25]
            [ISet,"Render:BPR Shadow:Rays",30]
            [ISet,"Render:BPR Shadow:Angle",15]
            [ISet,"Render:BPR AO:Rays",30]
            [ISet,"Render:BPR RenderPass:SPix",2]
            [IPress,"Render:BPR RenderPass:Render Best Preview"]
            [IUpdate,2,1]
            // Check ALL seven generated maps before exporting any for this view.
            [Loop,7,
                [If,[StrFind,"width=",[StrLower,[IGetInfo,rcPassIDs(rcPass)]]]<0,
                    [RoutineCall,RC_Fail,[StrMerge,"BPR map unavailable: ",rcPassNames(rcPass),". Render may have been cancelled."]]
                ]
            ,rcPass]
            [Loop,7,
                [RoutineCall,RC_Export,rcPassIDs(rcPass),[StrMerge,rcOutput,"/",rcPassNames(rcPass)]]
            ,rcPass]
        ]
    ,rcSlot]
    [RoutineCall,RC_Restore]
    [NoteBar,"BPR complete",1]
    [MessageOK,[StrMerge,rcCameraCount," cameras: 7 PSD files each. Output: ",rcRoot],"Render Capture"]
]
[IButton,"ZPlugin:Render Capture:1 - CREATE FOLDERS","Choose an output parent folder. Reuses ZPass_1 with folders for each enabled camera.",
    [RoutineCall,RC_CreateFolders]
,,1]
[IButton,"ZPlugin:Render Capture:2 - RENDER NON BPR","Export four PNG passes for all orange cameras and copy Z document to Screenshots with its camera number. Shadows OFF and active color white.",
    [RoutineCall,RC_NonBPR]
,,1]
[IButton,"ZPlugin:Render Capture:3 - RENDER BPR","Render all orange cameras and save AO, Composite, Depth, Mask, Shaded, Shadow and SSS as PSD.",
    [RoutineCall,RC_BPR]
,,1]
